items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I know one fellow who used to call Ray, he down in Chicago.

ctx.x: Oh, Diddy? Played trumpet? No. No. Another old time drummer. I think he played at Robichard. Chandler.
I know one fellow who used to call Ray, he down in Chicago.
